hooks.name: Menu_ItemGrid_Update
hooks.about: Updates native item-grid focus and selection; the result is a menu action, not a void callback.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemGrid_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the native item grid; preserve its returned render-pass flags.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemSlots_Update
hooks.about: Assigns the highlighted inventory entry to an eight-slot quick-select position.

hooks.name: Menu_QuickSelect_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the pause quick-select ring; preserve its render-pass flags.

hooks.name: Menu_QuickSelect_Load
hooks.about: Copies the saved eight quick-select entries into the native editor.

hooks.name: Menu_QuickSelect_Store
hooks.about: Commits the native editor entries to the saved quick-select array.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemText_Draw
hooks.about: Draws configured native menu text, including selected item names and descriptions.

hooks.name: Menu_ItemAmmo_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the selected inventory item ammunition using the native panel.

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_Bind
hooks.about: Binds the selected item and its attachments to the native preview.

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_Update
hooks.about: Creates or replaces the selected native inventory preview moby.

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_DrawAvailable
hooks.about: Draws owned selected-item preview mobys and returns render-pass flags.

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_DrawSelected
hooks.about: Draws the selected-item preview or its native missing-item message.

hooks.name: Menu_EquippedPreview_Update
hooks.about: Loads the native equipped hand-gadget preview.

hooks.name: Menu_EquippedPreview_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the native equipped-character preview objects.

hooks.name: Menu_Preview_Pose
hooks.about: Evaluates the class-specific native inventory preview pose and bindings.

hooks.name: Hud_QuickSelect_Init
hooks.about: Initializes the gameplay HUD eight-slot item selector.

hooks.name: Hud_QuickSelect_Update
hooks.about: Updates gameplay quick-select focus, visibility and chosen item.

hooks.name: Hud_QuickSelect_Draw
hooks.about: Draws the gameplay quick-select icons; preserve the native return value.

hooks.name: Vendor_MenuUpdate
hooks.about: Updates the modal Gadgetron purchase and ammunition state machine.

hooks.name: Vendor_InitializeSelected
hooks.about: Initializes native mobys and metadata for the selected vendor row.

hooks.name: Ammo_ChooseDrop
hooks.about: Chooses the native ammunition item through out_item and returns the native pickup count.

hooks.name: Ammo_SpawnDrop
hooks.about: Creates the native item ammunition pickup, retaining the original physics and collection.

hooks.name: Save_Prepare
hooks.about: Serializes current native save state and queues a full memory-card write.

hooks.name: Save_RequestAutosave
hooks.about: Serializes the native autosave packets and requests their memory-card update.

hooks.name: Save_Restore
hooks.about: Restores an in-memory whole native save; also used by default-state initialization.

hooks.name: Save_RestoreData
hooks.about: Restores a checksummed native save packet; file load invokes this directly.

hooks.name: Save_NewGame
hooks.about: Restores the disc default game state and selects level zero.

hooks.name: Save_NewGamePlus
hooks.about: Starts the native new-game-plus state reset while preserving carried progress.

hooks.name: Save_Serialize
hooks.about: Serializes the whole native save without starting memory-card IO.

hooks.name: Save_UpdateState
hooks.about: Advances the native memory-card IO state machine, including ordinary save-file loads.
